name: Ham
bio:
Ham is Noah's second son, whose descendants later scattered into the nations of Egypt, Cush, Canaan, and others (Genesis 10:6-20). He entered the ark with his brothers Shem and Japheth and their father Noah, surviving the flood's judgment.

After the flood, Noah became drunk and lay uncovered and asleep in his tent; Ham saw his father's nakedness and, rather than covering him, went out and told his two brothers — an act regarded as a severe dishonor to his father (Genesis 9:20-22). Upon waking, Noah did not curse Ham directly but cursed Ham's son Canaan instead, declaring that he would be a servant to his brothers (Genesis 9:24-25). Ham's lapse of respect became an important biblical example in discussions of honoring parents and family conduct.
